pages.text: Placing it builds a $(num)4$() wide, $(num)3$() tall monitor wall: one block left of where you place it, two to the right, two up. It needs the room.$(br2)Links to the nearest Reactor Core within $(num)32$() blocks. Breaking any part takes down the whole wall.

pages.title: The screen
pages.text: Shows the state, any countdown or fault, stability, ring stress, resonance, wobble, spin, offset, mass, laser power, stored energy and output. During a disc stall it shows a lamp for each stabilizer's breakers.$(br2)$(thing)Use a button on the screen$() to press it; the one you're looking at lights up. Sneak-use opens the old console panel.

pages.title: Buttons
pages.text: $(li)$(good)Ignite$(): start the reactor$(li)$(thing)Shutdown$(): safe stop$(li)$(danger)SCRAM$(): emergency stop$(li)$(thing)Jump$(): restart a stalled disc (RESET during a fault)$(li)$(thing)Offset -/+$(): spin$(li)$(thing)Laser -/+$(): laser power in 10% steps$(li)$(thing)◀ NW / SE ▶$(): axial trim against wobble$(li)$(warn)VENT$(): only with a Venting Lance
